submit_reasoning: The price history for PNR shows a gentle downtrend over the 137-bar window, with the last value at 54.80. Series stats show a mean of 56.34 with low coefficient of variation (2.5%), and no meaningful seasonality was detected. The anomaly detector flagged only one bar. Both history-only and event-informed forecasts produced identical trajectories because all five context events extracted from the article (earnings beat, 2023 guidance, Q1 guidance, upward estimate revisions, Zacks Hold rating) were rejected by the ablation gate. The selected model is a linear trend that projects a slight continued decline from ~55.37 to ~54.73 over 33 steps, which is consistent with the recent price action. Support is degraded due to limited evaluation folds, but this is the best available forecast.
